relevance.rationale: The corpus runs an entire research programme in Goncharov's name — conj:gb-depth-period-correspondence ('GS-depth <-> Goncharov period-depth'), conj:qou-infra-discharges-goncharov-zeta5, prop:borel-partial-resolution, prop:depth-2-identification-bloch-suslin, rem:transcendental-accounting (which cites Goncharov's 22-term relation for Li_3 at 5th roots) — and references.ts contains NO Goncharov entry at all (grep 'Goncharov' in references.ts = 0 hits; 37 hits across content/*.md). Those blocks currently cite bloch2000, suslin1991, zagier1986, kontsevich1995 as proxies. This paper is the foundational construction of the objects those blocks name: the tannakian category MT(O_S) of mixed Tate motives over the S-integers, the unipotent motivic fundamental group, and — §5 — the motivic pi_1 of P^1 minus {0, infinity, mu_N}, i.e. precisely the punctured-line-with-N-th-roots-of-unity setting in which QOU's zeta_5 / Li_3(zeta_5^k) depth-3 statements live. Most directly, §6 DEFINES the depth filtration D, which is the 'Goncharov period-depth' side of the corpus's keystone correspondence; the corpus currently uses that notion without a definition source.

keyResults.statement: The depth filtration D on the motivic fundamental group of X = P^1 minus {0, infinity, mu_N}: D^0 pi_1 = pi_1, D^1 pi_1 = ker(pi_1(X,x) -> pi_1(A*,x)), and D^n the n-th lower central series term of D^1; induced on Lie algebras, enveloping algebras and torsor affine algebras.
keyResults.useForFolio: This is the definition of the 'Goncharov period-depth' half of conj:gb-depth-period-correspondence, which the corpus's keystone correlates with GS-depth. The conjecture is currently stated against an undefined-in-corpus notion of depth; citing §6.1 fixes what the right-hand side of the correspondence means, including the caveat (§6.2) that the D-degree grading exists only in the omega-realisation and is not stable under u -> u^{-1}.

keyResults.locator: §5 (motivic pi_1 of P^1 \ {0, infinity, mu_N}); Introduction p. 2
keyResults.statement: Construction of the motivic unipotent fundamental group of the projective line punctured at 0, infinity and the N-th roots of unity, with the structure of the motivic Galois action on it; for N = 1 this yields Terasoma's upper bound in Zagier's conjecture on the number of Q-independent weight-w multiple zeta values.
keyResults.useForFolio: The mu_N setting is exactly where conj:qou-infra-discharges-goncharov-zeta5 (F = Q(zeta_5), depth 3) and conj:bring-trilog-depth-3-witness (the four values Li_3(zeta_5^k), k = 1..4) live. Citing §5 gives those blocks the actual motivic framework their statements presuppose, and the N = 1 / Zagier-bound remark is the correct source for rem:transcendental-accounting's MZV-dimension bookkeeping (currently unattributed).

keyResults.statement: Definition of the tannakian category MT(O_S) of mixed Tate motives over the ring of S-integers of a number field as a subcategory of MT(k), and its tannakian formalism; Ext groups of Q(0) by Q(n) match K-theory of k.
keyResults.useForFolio: prop:borel-partial-resolution reasons about K_5^{ind}(Q(zeta_5)) tensor Q having rank 2 and about a regulator into P_3/P_2. The Ext/K-theory dictionary in §1 is the statement that licenses moving between the K-group and the motivic side; the block currently cites only bloch2000/suslin1991.

proposedActions.rationale: Highest-value orphan in this slice: the corpus names a Goncharov conjecture in a block label and has zero Goncharov references. Create the ref() entry first.
conj:gb-depth-period-correspondence correlates GS-depth with 'Goncharov period-depth' but no block defines or sources the latter; §6.1 is the definition.
The zeta_5 / mu_N depth-3 blocks presuppose the motivic pi_1 of P^1 \ {0, infinity, mu_N} constructed in §5.

Record the §6.2 caveat that the D-degree grading refining the depth filtration exists only in the omega-realisation and is not stable under the involution u -> u^{-1} — relevant to whether the corpus's GS-depth <-> period-depth correspondence should be stated at the level of the filtration or the grading. This is a caveat to flag, not a proof aid; I have not checked which side the corpus intends.
